Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Discover BusinessWorks projects, processes, shared modules, adapters, EMS destinations, BusinessEvents assets, schemas, configuration files, and external endpoints.
Evidence Required: Asset inventory; repository scan; deployment manifests
Pass Criteria / Validation: All in-scope assets have an owner, location, version, and disposition
Automated Action / Enforcement: Block completeness sign-off if material assets remain unknown

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Construct a directed graph of process calls, shared resources, queues, topics, databases, APIs, and external systems.
Evidence Required: Static references; runtime traces; connection metadata
Pass Criteria / Validation: Material dependencies are represented and unresolved edges are flagged
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use graph centrality and coupling to identify migration boundaries

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Determine product versions, engine capabilities, adapter versions, Java dependencies, and deployment topology before choosing target libraries.
Evidence Required: Build files; manifests; runtime inventory; admin configuration
Pass Criteria / Validation: Versions and support constraints are recorded
Automated Action / Enforcement: Flag end-of-life components and incompatible dependencies

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Classify flows as request-response, asynchronous messaging, batch, event-driven, file transfer, orchestration, routing, or stateful processing.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Every process has a primary and optional secondary pattern
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use pattern-specific mappings and validation suites

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Infer business purpose from process names, mappings, payloads, logs, and documentation; distinguish inferred facts from verified requirements.
Evidence Required: Business documentation; owner interviews; representative payloads
Pass Criteria / Validation: Business purpose and assumptions are documented with provenance
Automated Action / Enforcement: Require SME review when business intent is uncertain or high impact

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Capture timeouts, retries, redelivery, ordering, transactions, error transitions, schedules, and restart behavior.
Evidence Required: Source configuration; runtime settings; operational runbooks
Pass Criteria / Validation: Operational semantics are documented per flow
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not infer defaults where deployed settings can be inspected

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Score complexity using branching, transformations, dependencies, exception paths, state, volume, and transaction coupling; do not rely on line count alone.
Evidence Required: Static analysis; dependency graph; process metadata
Pass Criteria / Validation: Complexity score includes explainable contributing factors
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use score for sequencing and estimates, not as an automatic architecture decision

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify environment variables, global variables, shared libraries, file paths, certificates, DNS names, scheduler dependencies, and runtime assumptions.
Evidence Required: Configuration files; deployment descriptors; environment inventory
Pass Criteria / Validation: Implicit dependencies are surfaced or explicitly marked unknown
Automated Action / Enforcement: Include infrastructure and operations dependencies, not just code references

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Where authorized, capture throughput, latency percentiles, failure rates, payload sizes, concurrency, and seasonality before migration.
Evidence Required: APM; logs; metrics; business volume reports
Pass Criteria / Validation: Baseline covers representative peak and off-peak periods
Automated Action / Enforcement: Record data window and confidence; avoid extrapolating from unrepresentative samples

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Classify assets as rehost, replatform, refactor, replace, consolidate, retire, or investigate, with a documented rationale.
Evidence Required: Inventory; business value; supportability; cost analysis
Pass Criteria / Validation: Every asset has disposition, rationale, owner, and approval where required
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not modernize assets that should be retired without business approval

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Record business owner, technical owner, data owner, downstream consumers, support team, and authoritative system for each flow.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Ownership and escalation paths are confirmed
Automated Action / Enforcement: Escalate orphaned or disputed ownership before cutover planning

Best Practice / Rule Name: Identify migration constraints and freeze windows
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Capture blackout periods, release calendars, contract obligations, partner dependencies, and permitted cutover windows.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Constraints appear in the migration plan and dependency schedule
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid scheduling high-risk cutovers during business-critical periods

Best Practice / Rule Name: Classify data sensitivity and business criticality
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Determine data classification, transaction criticality, recovery needs, retention, and regulatory obligations for each flow.
Evidence Required: Data catalog; risk assessment; compliance requirements
Pass Criteria / Validation: Classification and impact are recorded and approved
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use classifications to drive controls, testing, and approval requirements

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Inventory TIBCO, adapter, database, third-party, and target-cloud licensing and support terms.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Licensing impacts and end-of-support risks are documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not assume replacement eliminates licensing or support costs

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Attach each material finding to source paths, configuration, runtime evidence, timestamps, and confidence.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Reviewers can trace claims to evidence
Automated Action / Enforcement: Separate observed facts, inferred conclusions, and recommendations

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Select C#/.NET, Java, or another approved runtime using enterprise standards, skills, libraries, latency, deployment model, and TCO.
Evidence Required: Target standards; workload profile; skills and support model
Pass Criteria / Validation: Decision and alternatives are documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid a single-language mandate unless justified by enterprise policy

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map TIBCO activities to target capabilities by comparing behavior, state, errors, transactions, and guarantees—not component names.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Semantic differences and mitigations are documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: No automatic one-to-one mapping without semantic validation

Best Practice / Rule Name: Use the simplest architecture that meets requirements
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Prefer a direct service, worker, or managed primitive over new abstraction layers when functional and nonfunctional requirements are met.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Decision avoids unnecessary components and operational burden
Automated Action / Enforcement: Complexity must be justified by a measurable requirement

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Evaluate Functions/Lambda for suitable bounded event-driven work; containers or managed application hosting for sustained, long-running, or runtime-dependent workloads.
Evidence Required: Duration; memory; concurrency; startup; dependency profile
Pass Criteria / Validation: Compute choice fits runtime limits and operational needs
Automated Action / Enforcement: Verify current service limits, quotas, and hosting constraints

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Evaluate Durable Functions, Logic Apps, Step Functions, or application-level orchestration for durable state, long-running work, retries, and compensation.
Evidence Required: Workflow duration; state; human steps; retry and recovery needs
Pass Criteria / Validation: Workflow engine decision documents limits and semantics
Automated Action / Enforcement: Check history limits, replay behavior, payload limits, and execution model

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Evaluate Service Bus, Event Grid, Storage Queues, SQS, SNS, and EventBridge according to ordering, routing, filtering, retention, replay, throughput, and delivery guarantees.
Evidence Required: Messaging requirements; volume; ordering; replay needs
Pass Criteria / Validation: Selected service meets explicit requirement matrix
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not treat cloud messaging products as interchangeable

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Expose stable, versioned APIs through an appropriate gateway or management layer; keep internal workflow details out of public contracts.
Evidence Required: API catalog; consumer inventory; contract tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: External contract is independently versioned and documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid leaking implementation-specific schemas and errors

Best Practice / Rule Name: Define service boundaries around business capability
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Do not split every TIBCO process into a separate microservice; align boundaries with business ownership, consistency, deployment, and scaling needs.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Boundaries have explicit rationale and operational ownership
Automated Action / Enforcement: Prefer modular monolith or fewer services when distribution adds no value

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Create ADRs for material choices, including alternatives, constraints, trade-offs, evidence, assumptions, and reversal conditions.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Material decisions have an approved record
Automated Action / Enforcement: Revisit decisions when assumptions or platform capabilities change

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use portable interfaces when portability has value; use cloud-native services when benefits outweigh lock-in and exit costs.
Evidence Required: Portability requirements; cost and operations analysis
Pass Criteria / Validation: Portability strategy and lock-in risks are documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid costly abstraction solely for hypothetical future migration

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Set measurable requirements for availability, latency, throughput, security, scalability, operability, recoverability, and maintainability.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Quality attributes have measurable acceptance criteria
Automated Action / Enforcement: No target architecture approval without relevant NFRs

Best Practice / Rule Name: Check platform quotas and service limits
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Validate quotas, payload sizes, concurrency, throughput, timeout, retention, and regional availability for selected services.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Limits are compatible with projected peak and recovery traffic
Automated Action / Enforcement: Plan quota increases and load tests before production

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify writes to multiple systems and choose transactional outbox, CDC, orchestration, or reconciliation patterns as appropriate.
Evidence Required: Data flow; transaction boundaries; failure scenarios
Pass Criteria / Validation: Partial-failure behavior is defined and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not assume two independent writes are atomic

Best Practice / Rule Name: Define ownership of shared integration capabilities
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Assign ownership for common libraries, schemas, gateways, connectors, and reusable workflow components.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Support, versioning, and change authority are clear
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid shared components without an accountable owner

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Compare managed integration, commercial products, and custom code using capabilities, security, TCO, skills, and exit costs.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Decision is evidence-based and approved
Automated Action / Enforcement: Include operational toil and upgrade burden in comparisons

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Translate sequence, branches, loops, parallel paths, joins, and termination explicitly; test all material paths.
Evidence Required: Process graph; branch and loop tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Source-to-target control-flow coverage is demonstrated
Automated Action / Enforcement: Cover zero-result, failure, timeout, and cancellation paths

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify atomic operations and non-atomic steps; do not emulate distributed transactions with independent calls without a consistency strategy.
Evidence Required: Transaction configuration; database and messaging behavior
Pass Criteria / Validation: Transaction and rollback behavior is documented and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Require expert review for changed atomicity

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Persist workflow state for work spanning minutes, hours, or days; design for restart, duplicate signals, delayed callbacks, correlation, and deployment recovery.
Evidence Required: Workflow state; timeout and callback configuration
Pass Criteria / Validation: Restart and resume tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not rely on in-memory process state for durable workflows

Best Practice / Rule Name: Use saga patterns for distributed changes
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Where no shared transaction exists, define compensating actions, compensation failure handling, and reconciliation.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Compensation and recovery paths are tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: A compensation is a business operation, not always a literal rollback

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Preserve sequencing, join conditions, failure propagation, and required ordering; parallelize only when safe.
Evidence Required: Parallel branches; shared state; downstream limits
Pass Criteria / Validation: Concurrency and partial-failure tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid race conditions and unbounded fan-out

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Carry stable business correlation IDs through messages, workflow state, logs, and external calls.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Correlation survives asynchronous boundaries
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not use process memory as the only correlation store

Best Practice / Rule Name: Separate business rules from technical plumbing
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Keep decision logic testable and versioned; use a governed rules service only where complexity and reuse justify it.
Evidence Required: Business rules; mapping and transport code
Pass Criteria / Validation: Business rules have isolated tests and ownership
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid creating a separate rules platform for trivial logic

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Model approval tasks, authorization, deadlines, escalation, audit, and resume behavior when legacy processes depend on people.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Human tasks and exception paths are represented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Preserve who may approve and separation-of-duties controls

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Document time zones, daylight-saving behavior, calendars, missed-run recovery, overlap handling, and fixed-time versus interval schedules.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Schedule behavior is equivalent and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Specify catch-up and duplicate-run behavior

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify global variables, mutable singleton state, and implicit in-memory coordination; replace with correctly scoped state, persistence, or messaging.
Pass Criteria / Validation: State ownership and lifetime are explicit
Automated Action / Enforcement: Check multi-instance and horizontal-scaling behavior

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define how caller cancellation, workflow cancellation, and dependency timeouts propagate and how partial work is cleaned up.
Evidence Required: Source behavior; target cancellation tokens and APIs
Pass Criteria / Validation: Cancellation tests show no unintended orphaned work
Automated Action / Enforcement: Distinguish timeout from business cancellation

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map technical exceptions and business faults separately, retaining error codes, retryability, user-facing semantics, and audit requirements.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Error mapping is complete and consumer-compatible
Automated Action / Enforcement: Never retry deterministic business validation errors blindly

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify business invariants such as balances, status transitions, uniqueness, and required side effects, then test them independently of implementation.
Evidence Required: Business rules; domain models; reconciliation reports
Pass Criteria / Validation: Critical invariants have automated assertions
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use invariants to detect errors beyond output snapshots

Best Practice / Rule Name: Avoid accidental semantic changes during refactoring
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Separate behavior-preserving conversion from deliberate business changes; record and approve intentional differences.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Every intentional behavior change has approval and tests
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not bundle unrelated redesign into parity-critical conversion

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Determine whether a process can run concurrently for the same business key and protect critical sections or enforce serialization where required.
Evidence Required: Concurrency settings; runtime telemetry; domain rules
Pass Criteria / Validation: Same-key concurrency behavior is specified and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not introduce global locks where keyed coordination is sufficient

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Document at-most-once, at-least-once, or effectively-once business processing requirements; do not claim end-to-end exactly-once without proof.
Evidence Required: Broker configuration; target service semantics; failure tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Guarantees and limitations are explicit
Automated Action / Enforcement: Evaluate all hops, including database writes and external APIs

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use idempotency keys, deduplication records, or business-state checks when redelivery can repeat a side effect.
Evidence Required: Consumer code; idempotency store; duplicate tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Repeated delivery does not duplicate business effects
Automated Action / Enforcement: Choose key scope and retention based on business risk

Best Practice / Rule Name: Preserve ordering at the required scope
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Identify global, per-key, per-customer, or per-aggregate ordering and select partitioning, sessions, or FIFO features accordingly.
Evidence Required: Source broker settings; event sequence tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required ordering is maintained under concurrency and retries
Automated Action / Enforcement: Account for throughput and hot-partition trade-offs

Best Practice / Rule Name: Implement bounded retries and dead-letter handling
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define retryable errors, backoff, attempt limits, poison-message handling, dead-letter monitoring, and controlled replay.
Evidence Required: Retry policies; DLQ configuration; operational runbook
Pass Criteria / Validation: Retry exhaustion and DLQ recovery are tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid infinite retries and retry storms

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map correlation IDs, message IDs, timestamps, reply destinations, content types, priority, and custom headers; document replacements where needed.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required metadata is preserved or explicitly transformed
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid putting sensitive data in headers without controls

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use schema and API compatibility checks; introduce breaking changes through a versioned migration plan with an agreed overlap period.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Compatibility checks and consumer migration plan exist
Automated Action / Enforcement: Define deprecation dates and ownership

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define OpenAPI or equivalent contracts before implementation, including schemas, errors, auth, pagination, idempotency, and timeout behavior.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Implementation conforms to reviewed contract
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not infer public contracts solely from implementation code

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Bound queues, concurrency, buffering, and downstream request rates; define behavior when consumers lag or dependencies fail.
Evidence Required: Capacity model; queue metrics; load tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Backlog limits and overload behavior are tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Plan for recovery traffic after outages

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Set request deadlines, downstream timeouts, and cancellation behavior; ensure retries do not exceed business deadlines.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Worst-case timing is within approved budget or returns a defined failure
Automated Action / Enforcement: Budget time across all hops, not separately per hop

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define replay windows, auditability, event ordering, duplicate effects, and downstream protections before enabling replay or bulk recovery.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Replay is authorized, bounded, and observable
Automated Action / Enforcement: Separate replay from normal consumer traffic where needed

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map reply destinations, correlation, callback expiration, late replies, and orphaned requests to the target pattern.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Success, timeout, late-reply, and failure paths are tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid assuming queue and HTTP request-response semantics match

Best Practice / Rule Name: Validate payload size and schema evolution
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Check broker and API size limits, schema compatibility, optional fields, unknown fields, and large-message handling.
Evidence Required: Payload samples; service limits; schema tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Boundary-size and compatibility tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use object storage references for large payloads only with access and lifecycle controls

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Translate content-based routing, selectors, subscriptions, and filters while checking null behavior, case sensitivity, and expression differences.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Routing decision table matches source behavior
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not assume expression languages share syntax or semantics

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Bound subscriber count, concurrency, retries, and downstream effects for broadcast and event fan-out patterns.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Fan-out capacity and failure isolation are demonstrated
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid unbounded retries across every subscriber

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Standardize JSON, XML, Avro, Protobuf, or other formats based on interoperability, evolution, size, and governance needs.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Serialization format and evolution policy are documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not convert formats without verifying precision and namespace semantics

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Translate XPath, XSLT, mapper expressions, and custom functions while preserving namespaces, defaults, type conversions, ordering, and conditional behavior.
Evidence Required: Source mappings; golden payloads; transformation tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Representative and edge-case outputs match expected results
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test empty, missing, malformed, and repeated elements

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use explicit decimal precision and rounding policies; avoid binary floating point for financial calculations unless source behavior requires it.
Evidence Required: Source types; target types; boundary values
Pass Criteria / Validation: Rounding and precision tests match approved behavior
Automated Action / Enforcement: Document scale, rounding mode, overflow, and currency rules

Best Practice / Rule Name: Handle dates, time zones, and locale explicitly
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define timestamp formats, UTC conversion, local business dates, daylight-saving rules, locale parsing, and date-only versus instant semantics.
Evidence Required: Source formats; timezone settings; test vectors
Pass Criteria / Validation: Date and time edge cases pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Never rely on host machine locale or timezone defaults

Best Practice / Rule Name: Preserve null, empty, missing, zero, and false distinctions
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Treat null, empty string, omitted field, zero, false, and empty collection as distinct when business behavior depends on them.
Evidence Required: Source schema; mapping rules; test payloads
Pass Criteria / Validation: All meaningful states have explicit mapping behavior
Automated Action / Enforcement: Watch language-specific defaults and serializer omission rules

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Validate required fields, types, enumerations, lengths, and compatibility at trusted boundaries; handle invalid or unknown fields intentionally.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Invalid data is rejected or quarantined according to policy
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid silently dropping fields needed by downstream consumers

Best Practice / Rule Name: Preserve encoding and binary payload behavior
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Verify character encodings, XML namespaces, escaping, compression, attachments, binary content, and maximum payload sizes.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Non-ASCII, binary, and boundary-size tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not decode binary content as text without evidence

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Analyze stored procedures, isolation, locking, transaction scope, generated keys, null semantics, and query behavior before changing drivers or access patterns.
Evidence Required: SQL; schema; driver settings; transaction tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Data correctness and transaction behavior are verified
Automated Action / Enforcement: Include triggers, sequences, collation, and implicit conversions

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Keep structural mapping, business validation, and enrichment as distinct testable responsibilities where this improves clarity and defect isolation.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Each responsibility can be tested and changed independently
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid over-fragmenting trivial transformations

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Preserve source identifiers, provenance, audit timestamps, version markers, and business references required for reconciliation or regulation.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required audit attributes survive end-to-end
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use trusted timestamps and avoid spoofable provenance

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Avoid repeated parsing, serialization, enrichment, and large payload copies; stream or batch within safe resource bounds.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Resource usage is measured and within target limits
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not trade away correctness or observability for micro-optimizations

Best Practice / Rule Name: Preserve database key and collation semantics
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Check case sensitivity, collation, uniqueness, identity/sequence generation, key format, and ordering assumptions when moving databases or runtimes.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Uniqueness and lookup behavior are equivalent
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test non-ASCII and case-variant values where relevant

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Preserve batch size, commit frequency, restart checkpoints, partial-failure handling, and duplicate prevention for file or bulk processing.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Restarting a batch does not lose or duplicate unapproved work
Automated Action / Enforcement: Size batches for memory, transaction, and rate limits

Best Practice / Rule Name: Handle malformed and partial data safely
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define validation, quarantine, rejection, partial acceptance, and remediation behavior for malformed or incomplete records.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Bad-data paths are observable and recoverable
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not silently coerce invalid business-critical values

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Move only data required for processing; apply retention, deletion, masking, and archival rules to payloads, logs, replay stores, and backups.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Data lifecycle is documented and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Ensure replay and dead-letter stores do not bypass retention policy

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define counts, totals, checksums, status distributions, and business-level reconciliation for migrated records and transactions.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Differences are within approved tolerance and explained
Automated Action / Enforcement: Reconciliation should detect missing, duplicated, and altered records

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Never migrate passwords, API keys, certificates, or connection secrets into source code, generated configuration, or logs.
Evidence Required: Secret scan; configuration review; vault references
Pass Criteria / Validation: No active secrets are embedded in delivered artifacts
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use Key Vault, Secrets Manager, or an approved equivalent

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use managed identities, workload identities, or IAM roles where supported; grant only necessary actions and resources.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Permissions are least-privilege and reviewed
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid long-lived static cloud credentials

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Document inbound/outbound identity, trust boundaries, scopes, roles, and service-to-service auth; do not rely on network location alone.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Unauthorized requests are denied and authorized paths work
Automated Action / Enforcement: Preserve principal identity across asynchronous handoffs where needed

Best Practice / Rule Name: Encrypt data in transit and at rest
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Validate TLS versions, certificate trust, encryption configuration, key ownership, and rotation; assess weak legacy protocols.
Evidence Required: TLS settings; storage configuration; certificate inventory
Pass Criteria / Validation: Approved encryption standards are met
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test certificate renewal and trust-chain failures

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Redact secrets, personal data, payment data, and confidential payloads from logs, traces, errors, and agent-generated evidence.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Sensitive-data tests show no prohibited leakage
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use allowlisted fields rather than logging entire payloads

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map private endpoints, firewall rules, segmentation, egress restrictions, and approved connectivity; avoid unnecessary public exposure.
Evidence Required: Network diagrams; cloud policies; reachability tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Only approved paths are reachable
Automated Action / Enforcement: Validate DNS and private endpoint behavior in each environment

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Determine classification, retention, residency, audit, and regulatory constraints before selecting regions, services, or storage.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Region and service choices meet approved requirements
Automated Action / Enforcement: Include backups, telemetry, disaster recovery, and support access

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Run static analysis, software composition analysis, secret detection, license checks, and vulnerability scans against generated and third-party code.
Evidence Required: CI scan reports; SBOM; policy configuration
Pass Criteria / Validation: Policy-defined release thresholds pass or have approved waivers
Automated Action / Enforcement: Pin and review dependencies; monitor newly disclosed vulnerabilities

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use parameterized queries, safe XML processing, output encoding, path validation, and strict input validation to prevent injection and unsafe parsing.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Injection test suite passes
Automated Action / Enforcement: Disable unsafe XML external entity processing where applicable

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use approved TLS, headers, CORS, cookie, runtime, container, filesystem, and service hardening settings appropriate to the workload.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Environment meets approved baseline
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not copy insecure legacy defaults

Best Practice / Rule Name: Define audit trails and privileged access
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Log security-relevant actions, administrative changes, approvals, and access to sensitive operations with tamper-resistant retention where required.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required events are recorded and reviewable
Automated Action / Enforcement: Restrict access to logs and audit stores

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Assess spoofing, tampering, repudiation, information disclosure, denial of service, and privilege escalation at system boundaries.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Material threats have controls, owners, and residual-risk approval
Automated Action / Enforcement: Repeat threat modeling after significant architecture changes

Best Practice / Rule Name: Secure supply chain and build provenance
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use controlled build identities, signed artifacts where supported, trusted registries, dependency pinning, and provenance records.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Build and artifact origin can be verified
Automated Action / Enforcement: Separate build permissions from runtime permissions

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Specify timeouts, retry budgets, circuit breakers, concurrency limits, and fallback behavior for each critical dependency.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Failure behavior is bounded and tested
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid retry amplification during outages

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define which functions may degrade, queue work, or return controlled errors when dependencies fail; do not silently drop critical transactions.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Degraded behavior is approved and observable
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use fallbacks only when business semantics remain safe

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Ensure restarts, instance replacement, and deployments do not lose durable workflow state or corrupt in-flight transactions.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Restart and failover tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test termination at multiple points in the workflow

Best Practice / Rule Name: Set measurable SLOs and error budgets
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define latency percentiles, throughput, availability, error rates, and recovery objectives from business needs and measured baselines.
Pass Criteria / Validation: SLOs have measurement method and owners
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not choose arbitrary performance targets

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Emit structured logs, metrics, and distributed traces with correlation IDs, business outcome codes, and dependency timing.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Critical paths can be traced end-to-end
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use Azure Monitor or AWS observability tools as appropriate

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define RTO/RPO, backups, restore, regional failure scenarios, replay, and periodic recovery tests.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Recovery objectives are demonstrated, not merely documented
Automated Action / Enforcement: Include identity, secrets, network, DNS, and dependencies in recovery

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Estimate compute, messaging, storage, observability, networking, licensing, support, idle capacity, peak load, and operations labor.
Evidence Required: Pricing estimates; load profiles; cost reports
Pass Criteria / Validation: Cost model states assumptions and sensitivity
Automated Action / Enforcement: Compare cost per business transaction, not just infrastructure spend

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use version-controlled infrastructure as code, environment-specific configuration, repeatable builds, deployment gates, and tested rollback.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Environment can be recreated reproducibly
Automated Action / Enforcement: Prevent secrets and environment drift in IaC

Best Practice / Rule Name: Capacity-plan for normal, peak, and recovery load
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Model normal, seasonal peak, burst, retry, and post-outage recovery traffic; validate autoscaling and downstream limits.
Evidence Required: Traffic history; load tests; quota checks
Pass Criteria / Validation: Capacity meets agreed targets under realistic scenarios
Automated Action / Enforcement: Account for queue drain time and downstream rate limits

Best Practice / Rule Name: Use health checks and dependency readiness
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Separate liveness, readiness, and dependency health; prevent unhealthy instances from accepting work and avoid cascading restarts.
Evidence Required: Health endpoints; orchestrator config; chaos tests
Pass Criteria / Validation: Health signals match operational intent
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not make liveness depend on transient downstream outages

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Document alert response, replay, dead-letter remediation, certificate renewal, failover, rollback, and escalation ownership.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Operators can execute critical procedures
Automated Action / Enforcement: Validate runbooks with exercises before cutover

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Stop accepting new work, complete or safely checkpoint in-flight work, and drain connections during deployment or scale-in.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Shutdown does not lose or duplicate work beyond approved semantics
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test termination signals and maximum shutdown windows

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Bound threads, connection pools, memory, file handles, queue consumers, and parallel branches; protect against unbounded resource growth.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Resource ceilings and saturation behavior are known
Automated Action / Enforcement: Test slow downstreams and large payloads

Best Practice / Rule Name: Monitor business outcomes, not just infrastructure
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Track completed, rejected, delayed, duplicated, and reconciled business transactions in addition to CPU, memory, and queue metrics.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Business-level health and technical health are both visible
Automated Action / Enforcement: Define alert thresholds with business owners

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Set log retention, sampling, metric cardinality, payload capture, and trace sampling policies while preserving required audit evidence.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Observability remains useful and within budget
Automated Action / Enforcement: Never sample away mandatory security or compliance audit events

Best Practice / Rule Name: Generate code only from verified context
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Provide source assets, dependency information, contracts, approved patterns, and target standards; identify missing context rather than inventing behavior.
Evidence Required: Context package; source references; agent trace
Pass Criteria / Validation: Generated artifacts identify evidence and unresolved assumptions
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use confidence thresholds to route uncertain cases to humans

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Map every material source process, activity, transformation, and exception path to target code, configuration, tests, or approved retirement.
Evidence Required: Traceability matrix; code references; test links
Pass Criteria / Validation: No material source behavior is unmapped without disposition
Automated Action / Enforcement: Trace both directions: source-to-target and target-to-source

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Build tests from source behavior, representative payloads, and edge cases before relying on generated implementation.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Baseline tests cover critical paths and known edge cases
Automated Action / Enforcement: When legacy execution is unavailable, document alternate evidence and residual uncertainty

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Run equivalent inputs through legacy and target in a controlled environment; compare outputs, side effects, errors, ordering, and material timing.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Differences are classified, explained, and approved or fixed
Automated Action / Enforcement: Normalize only non-semantic differences; retain raw evidence

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Prioritize financial logic, security boundaries, high-volume flows, rare errors, and central dependencies; define coverage thresholds by policy.
Evidence Required: Risk score; test coverage; impact analysis
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required risk-weighted tests pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Code coverage alone is not proof of behavioral parity

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: When equivalent mapping cannot be established, record uncertainty and require expert review; never silently replace transaction, ordering, or delivery guarantees.
Pass Criteria / Validation: No unresolved critical semantic gap proceeds without approved disposition
Automated Action / Enforcement: Low confidence should trigger investigation, not optimistic acceptance

Best Practice / Rule Name: Require human approval for high-risk decisions
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Gate changes to security, financial logic, data deletion, transaction boundaries, external contracts, and irreversible migration actions behind authorized review.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Required approvals are recorded before execution or release
Automated Action / Enforcement: Define approver roles and separation of duties

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Store rule ID, evidence references, confidence, assessment result, approver, exception rationale, expiry, and remediation plan.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Every exception has owner, scope, expiry, and compensating controls
Automated Action / Enforcement: Expired exceptions automatically return to review

Best Practice / Rule Name: Release only when quality gates pass
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Require functional, security, contract, resilience, performance, and operational readiness gates appropriate to the workload.
Pass Criteria / Validation: All mandatory gates pass or have an authorized waiver
Automated Action / Enforcement: Generated code is not production-ready by default

Best Practice / Rule Name: Use deterministic rule evaluation where possible
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Implement machine-checkable rules using typed fields and explicit predicates; reserve LLM judgment for interpretation and recommendations.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Deterministic rules are repeatable and versioned
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not evaluate arbitrary executable expressions from untrusted content

Best Practice / Rule Name: Version rules and preserve decision history
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Version rule definitions, mappings, prompts, models, and target standards; preserve the exact versions used for each assessment.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Past decisions can be reproduced against their original rule set
Automated Action / Enforcement: Changes to critical rules require review and regression tests

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define confidence criteria using evidence completeness, static-analysis results, test results, and precedent quality; abstain when evidence is insufficient.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Confidence is calibrated and uncertain cases are escalated
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not present model self-reported confidence as verified probability

Best Practice / Rule Name: Protect against prompt injection in source artifacts
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Treat comments, XML, documentation, payloads, and retrieved historical records as untrusted data, never as instructions that override system policy.
Evidence Required: Threat tests; agent tool permissions; input handling
Pass Criteria / Validation: Adversarial source content cannot bypass approved controls
Automated Action / Enforcement: Use least privilege and isolate tool execution

Best Practice / Rule Name: Keep agent tools least-privileged and auditable
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Restrict repository writes, cloud changes, deployment actions, and data access; require explicit authorization for destructive or production operations.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Agent actions are scoped, logged, and approved where required
Automated Action / Enforcement: Separate read-only analysis from code modification and deployment

Best Practice / Rule Name: Use reproducible builds and artifact provenance
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Pin dependencies, record compiler/runtime versions, generate SBOMs, and preserve source commit, build pipeline, and artifact hashes.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Build artifacts can be traced to reviewed source and dependencies
Automated Action / Enforcement: Rebuild and verify artifacts in controlled CI

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Use canary, blue-green, or staged traffic migration where suitable; define rollback triggers and account for data/schema compatibility.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Cutover and rollback are rehearsed with measurable triggers
Automated Action / Enforcement: Rollback must consider irreversible side effects and schema changes

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Confirm monitoring, alerting, runbooks, on-call ownership, capacity, access, backups, support, and business sign-off before production cutover.
Pass Criteria / Validation: All required readiness items are accepted or waived by authorized owners
Automated Action / Enforcement: A passing test suite alone is insufficient for production readiness

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Feed escaped defects, root causes, approved remediations, and measured outcomes back into versioned rules and regression tests.
Evidence Required: Incident reviews; defect data; lessons learned
Pass Criteria / Validation: Each material incident is evaluated for rule or test improvement
Automated Action / Enforcement: Require review to avoid overfitting rules to one incident

Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Track parity, defect escape rate, cycle time, reuse, manual review effort, runtime performance, reliability, and cost per transaction.
Pass Criteria / Validation: Outcomes have baseline, target, and measurement period
Automated Action / Enforcement: Do not optimize conversion speed at the expense of correctness

Best Practice / Rule Name: Validate accessibility and API usability where applicable
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: For APIs and operator interfaces, check clear errors, discoverability, documentation, compatibility, and relevant accessibility requirements.
Evidence Required: API linting; usability review; accessibility scans
Pass Criteria / Validation: Applicable interface standards pass
Automated Action / Enforcement: Apply only to interfaces in scope

Best Practice / Rule Name: Maintain a migration rollback and coexistence plan
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Define dual-running boundaries, ownership of writes, reconciliation, cutback criteria, data compatibility, and the point after which rollback is unsafe.
Evidence Required: Cutover design; rollback rehearsal; data ownership
Pass Criteria / Validation: Rollback/coexistence strategy is tested and approved
Automated Action / Enforcement: Avoid uncontrolled dual writes and split-brain processing

Best Practice / Rule Name: Validate historical pattern reuse before applying it
Codified Rule / Expert Guidance: Retrieve prior modernization examples with matching semantics, versions, constraints, and outcomes; check whether assumptions still apply.
Evidence Required: Experience repository; similarity and applicability review
Pass Criteria / Validation: Reused pattern includes provenance and applicability assessment
Automated Action / Enforcement: Similarity alone is insufficient; reject stale or context-mismatched precedent
